description: New research from the University of St Andrews has shed light on the evolution of an important yet thus far poorly understood group of marine invertebrate animals—brachiopods. title: Who really made China's Terracotta Army? Fingerprints reveal new clues

But new research on this underground army and its chariots, horses and weapons suggests women and children lent a helping hand.
